create_list_concatenate: concatenate multiple list Series into a single list Series with list.concat
create_list_set_operations: compute set union, intersection, difference, or symmetric difference between two list Series
create_list_to_struct: convert a list Series to a struct Series with configurable field names and width strategy
create_list_filter_elements: filter elements in each list by a boolean expression using list.filter
create_list_eval_expression: run any polars expression against the elements of each list using list.eval
